name: abnormal-promo-video
description: The promo video on the Abnormal website home page, written with Remotion and rendered into public/video/.

scripts.render: pnpm music && pnpm render:en && pnpm render:zh && pnpm render:en-dark && pnpm render:zh-dark
scripts.render:en: remotion render promo-en ../public/video/abnormal-en.mp4 && remotion still promo-en ../public/video/abnormal-en.jpg --frame=220
scripts.render:zh: remotion render promo-zh ../public/video/abnormal-zh.mp4 && remotion still promo-zh ../public/video/abnormal-zh.jpg --frame=220
scripts.render:en-dark: remotion render promo-en-dark ../public/video/abnormal-en-dark.mp4 && remotion still promo-en-dark ../public/video/abnormal-en-dark.jpg --frame=220
scripts.render:zh-dark: remotion render promo-zh-dark ../public/video/abnormal-zh-dark.mp4 && remotion still promo-zh-dark ../public/video/abnormal-zh-dark.jpg --frame=220
